name: Neon
model: Serverless PostgreSQL (Postgres 14 -- 18): standard tables and SQL, plus instant copy-on-write database branches
engine_note: Postgres compute; WAL sent to safekeepers (Paxos quorum), pageservers rebuild pages from WAL, long-term history kept in object storage
consistency: Postgres transaction semantics on the primary compute (read committed default, serializable option). A commit is acknowledged once a majority of safekeepers have its WAL. Read replicas are separate computes reading the same storage and can lag slightly.
scaling: Separated storage and compute; compute autoscales up and down and scales to zero when idle; read replicas share storage; no write sharding.
licence: Apache License 2.0 (storage and platform code on GitHub); Postgres itself under the PostgreSQL Licence

licence_events.event: Databricks announced it would acquire Neon; Neon now operates as 'Neon at Databricks' and its serverless Postgres underpins Databricks Lakebase. Licence unchanged.

version_note: Latest changelog entry 2026-10-02 (free plan storage doubled to 1 GB per project). On 2026-09-18 the 'Neon backend' (Postgres, Auth, Functions, Object Storage, AI Gateway) reached general availability.
reach: Reach for it when you want Postgres that costs nothing while idle, many short-lived databases (per-branch, per-test, per-agent), or preview environments.
avoid: Avoid when you need steady low latency on a large always-on database, or cannot accept cold starts after scale to zero.
escape: Adds scale to zero, autoscaling compute and instant database branches over plain Postgres.
chat: Users, chats and messages for a small or early product; a throwaway branch per pull request for testing.
notes: Acquisition: Databricks announced the agreement on 2025-05-14 (deal value not stated in the press release; widely reported as about 1 billion USD, not confirmed from a primary source). The 2026 docs and changelog brand the architecture 'Lakebase Postgres' and search extensions 'Lakebase Search'. GitHub releases on neondatabase/neon stopped at July 2025 tags although the repo is still pushed to (last push 2026-08-31) and still Apache-2.0; self-hosting from source is possible but not a supported product, so self_hosted is a stretch. Commit-on-safekeeper-quorum quoted from the architecture overview (read 2026-10-04). Vercel Postgres integration listed from general knowledge, not re-verified.
